title: Anchor One Proof to Its Immutable Source
teaser: Evidence is useful only when its origin can be reproduced later.
full_text: For one verification artifact record source version retrieval date and checksum beside the expected result.

title: Cold Start With Every Network Path Disabled
teaser: Offline support must survive a fresh process rather than only an already loaded screen.
full_text: Terminate the app disable connectivity and verify the required local state opens without hidden network dependency.

title: Exercise the Unknown Birth Time Contract
teaser: A missing birth time must not be replaced by a silent invented default.
full_text: Create a profile with unknown time and verify only calculations explicitly allowed by the contract are produced.

title: Reconcile PDF Bookmarks After Pagination Changes
teaser: Long report edits can move sections while leaving stale navigation targets.
full_text: Generate an oversized report and compare every bookmark destination with the actual section start page.

title: Display Backup Migration Before Commit
teaser: A restore should explain how an older schema will be transformed before data changes.
full_text: In the restore preview show source version target version and the ordered migration operations before confirmation.

title: Preserve the Instant When Timezone Display Changes
teaser: Changing a timezone label must not mutate the astronomical moment already stored.
full_text: Render one persisted event through another timezone and verify the underlying UTC instant remains identical.

title: Announce Control State to Assistive Technology
teaser: A label without selected locked or expanded state leaves an accessibility gap.
full_text: Inspect a toggle and a locked PRO action and verify accessible name role and state are all exposed.

title: Guard PRO Deep Links at the Domain Boundary
teaser: A hidden menu is irrelevant if a protected route can still execute directly.
full_text: Invoke a PRO-only deep link under a Free entitlement and verify no protected calculation or payload is returned.

title: Disambiguate Identically Named Places
teaser: Location search must not collapse different cities into one ambiguous choice.
full_text: Use two same-name city fixtures and verify country region and coordinate clues remain distinct in selection UI.

title: Redact Human Labels From Diagnostics
teaser: Sensitive information may appear in names and notes even when dates are masked.
full_text: Trigger a synthetic failure and confirm profile names client labels and notes are absent from plaintext diagnostics.

title: Reauthorize an Open Dialog After Resume
teaser: A modal opened before backgrounding cannot keep stale purchase permissions forever.
full_text: Change entitlement while backgrounded then resume and verify the open action is evaluated against the new state.

title: Make CSV Column Order a Stable Contract
teaser: Equivalent values in a different column order can still break downstream tooling.
full_text: Export a fixture and compare its header ordering byte-for-byte with the canonical schema.

title: Canonicalize Negative Zero in Presented Results
teaser: Tiny floating errors can surface as confusing negative zero values.
full_text: Run a boundary fixture that produces signed zero internally and verify presentation normalizes it to canonical zero.

title: Compare Placeholder Sets Across Locales
teaser: Independent prose can still share an exact runtime parameter contract.
full_text: For one content key compare TR and EN placeholder names and required parameters as unordered sets.

title: Verify Asset Size Together With Its Digest
teaser: A matching filename does not prove the packaged asset is the expected file.
full_text: Check one bundled asset against both manifest byte length and cryptographic digest before accepting it.

title: Require Locale Inside Every New Editorial Row
teaser: Directory placement should not substitute for the canonical row contract.
full_text: Feed the new-batch parser a row without locale and verify it fails safely rather than inferring the value.

title: Resist Device Clock Rollback in PIN Throttling
teaser: Moving the wall clock backward must not erase brute-force waiting periods.
full_text: Create failed PIN attempts rewind device time and verify the throttle continues from a monotonic source.

title: Respect Notification Denial Without Re-Prompt Loops
teaser: A denied permission should not cause the system dialog to reappear on every launch.
full_text: Deny notification permission relaunch and verify a new prompt occurs only after an explicit eligible user action.

title: Pin the Exact Sunset Boundary for Planetary Hours
teaser: One boundary mistake can assign the first night segment incorrectly.
full_text: Test one second before sunset the exact instant and one second after against the expected segment indices.

title: Refresh the Empty-State Origin After Creation
teaser: Navigation is incomplete if a newly created record is invisible when the user returns.
full_text: Create through the empty-state CTA navigate back and verify the item appears without a manual refresh.

title: Erase Temporary Material After Wrong Backup Password
teaser: Failed decryption must not leave partial sensitive bytes behind.
full_text: Attempt restore with an invalid password then inspect temporary storage for plaintext fragments or partial archives.

title: Make the BaZi Day-Boundary Policy Explicit
teaser: Different schools can move the day transition around Zi hour and hidden assumptions are dangerous.
full_text: Lock fixtures at 22:59 23:00 and 23:01 to the selected policy and verify the day-pillar transition exactly.

title: Align Chart Focus Order With Time Order
teaser: Assistive navigation through a trend should follow the meaning of the dataset.
full_text: For a time-series chart verify semantic focus advances in the same chronological order as the points.

title: Version Professional Presets Instead of Mutating History
teaser: Past consultations should not change meaning when a preset is edited later.
full_text: Edit a preset and verify an older consultation still resolves to its immutable preset version.

title: Search the Release Artifact for Debug Surfaces
teaser: Code can remain dangerous even when a debug menu is visually hidden.
full_text: Scan release route strings flags and configuration for forbidden debug or staging patterns and require zero matches.

title: Measure Contrast for Interactive States Separately
teaser: Passing base colors does not guarantee selected error or disabled states remain accessible.
full_text: Measure foreground and background pairs for error selected disabled and link states independently.

title: Restore Relationships During Delete Undo
teaser: Undo is incomplete when the parent returns but linked metadata does not.
full_text: Delete a related record invoke undo and verify foreign-key links ordering and metadata are restored together.

title: Derive October Dates From the Calendar
teaser: Hand-authored date lists can conceal a missing or duplicated day.
full_text: Generate the expected October 2034 date set programmatically and compare it exactly with both locale shards.

title: Enforce One Record Per Locale Per Date
teaser: A duplicate day can hide behind a correct-looking monthly total.
full_text: For every October date verify exactly one canonical TR row and one canonical EN row with no duplicate key.

title: Recompute Editorial Coverage From Committed Files
teaser: A progress counter should be derivable rather than trusted as handwritten state.
full_text: Scan committed shards from 2026-01-01 and derive contiguous end date and record totals for each locale.

title: Close October With an Exact Continuation Point
teaser: The next batch boundary should be a machine-readable date rather than a vague month label.
full_text: Write 2034-11-01 into checkpoint and ledger and reconcile it against physical October coverage.
